test_DataFrameFormatter_max_rows_fitted: test the DataFrameFormatter class to compute the correct number of rows to display based on max_rows and min_rows options
test_SeriesFormatter_east_asian_unicode: test the SeriesFormatter class for proper alignment of East Asian Unicode characters in Series repr
test_FloatArrayFormatter_output_precisio: test the FloatArrayFormatter class to format float values with correct precision and trailing zero handling
test_Datetime64Formatter_mixed_precision: test the _Datetime64Formatter class to format datetime values with varying precision from seconds to nanoseconds
test_Timedelta64Formatter_days_and_subda: test the _Timedelta64Formatter class to format timedelta values in days and sub-day units including negative values
test_format_percentiles_rounding: test the format_percentiles function to format percentile values as percentage strings with proper rounding
test_east_asian_unicode_repr: test DataFrame repr formatting with East Asian Unicode characters using the display.unicode.east_asian_width option
test_repr_truncation_with_options: test DataFrame repr truncation behavior with display.max_rows, display.max_columns, and display.max_colwidth options
